user.title: Ermangizer RS-485 bus
user.description: How is the bus with the pump controllers reachable from Home Assistant? Individual controllers are added next.

network.title: Gateway connection
network.description: Address and port of the RS-485-to-Ethernet gateway. With a multi-port gateway each serial port is usually a separate TCP port - configure one integration entry per port.

data_description.wait_between_requests_ms: Minimum silence between two Modbus requests on this bus. Raise it if you see timeouts or garbled reads; 0 disables the pause.

serial.title: Serial connection
serial.description: Local serial device of the USB-RS485 adapter and the settings configured in the controllers (Ermangizer default is 9600-N-1).

data_description.wait_between_requests_ms: Minimum silence between two Modbus requests on this bus. Raise it if you see timeouts or garbled reads; 0 disables the pause.

pump.title: Add a controller
pump.description: One pump controller on this bus.

data_description.layout: Automatic detection reads one status register from each documented map and picks the one that answers. Choose a map explicitly if the controller answers on both.
data_description.poll_interval: How often the run/stop state is read. Automations trigger on this.
data_description.slow_poll_interval: How often analogue telemetry and parameters are read. Keep this well above the state interval: the bus is half duplex.
data_description.access_level: Which parameters are exposed. Higher levels include parameters that change how the pump runs.

error.duplicate_unit_id: This Modbus address is already used on this bus.
